design_philosophy: Color is function. 95% of the UI is monochrome to let the data (maps, urgency, scores) be the hero. Sharp, grid-based layouts to convey authority, trust, and smart resource allocation.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing for marketing, Dense Control Room for dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Use padding p-6 or p-8 inside bordered containers.
spacing_and_layout.dashboards: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Use grid borders to expose the skeleton.
spacing_and_layout.landing_page: Tetris Grid with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Aggressive asymmetry.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: Rounded-none or rounded-sm (max 4px) to maintain the rigid Swiss look.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Secondary: border border-[#111111] bg-transparent hover:bg-[#111111] hover:text-white.
components.cards: Flat background (#FFFFFF), 1px solid border (#E5E5E5), no soft drop shadows. On hover, use a harsh offset shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#111111]) for tactile feedback.
components.badges: Font-mono, uppercase, text-xs. 1px solid border. Color matches the urgency or category.
components.progress_bars: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Background #E5E5E5, fill uses the score_* functional colors.
components.maps: Use light/silver map styles. Overlay data with high-contrast heatmaps (Signal Red to Warning Yellow) for instant urgency recognition.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Harsh, immediate offset shadows or background inversions. No muddy/slow fades.
motion_and_interactions.data_viz: Staggered entrance animations for bento grid cards. Progress bars fill sequentially.

media.icons: lucide-react (already installed). Use sharp, consistent stroke widths (1.5px or 2px).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. The dark #111111 on #FAFAFA easily passes.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., 'ngo-post-task-button', 'volunteer-accept-match').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the color palette. Do not add any new colors. Rely on layout, grid borders, and spacing for visual hierarchy instead of color overload.
Implement the 'Control Room' grid layout for the NGO, Volunteer, and Admin dashboards. Every card must have a 1px border. No soft shadows.
Use Shadcn components but strip out their default rounded corners (set to rounded-none or rounded-sm) to match the Swiss/Brutalist aesthetic.
For the Heatmap, ensure the map tiles are light/monochrome so the high-contrast red/yellow hot spots immediately draw the eye.
Ensure the AI Matching score breakdown uses 4 distinct progress bars with the assigned functional colors (Blue, Green, Yellow, Red) for clarity.
Do not use placeholder image URLs. Only use the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is applied to all H1-H4 headings and 'IBM Plex Sans' to body text.
For .js files, define functional React components. The design rules apply purely to Tailwind utility classes.
